plans.idea: Editorial left-aligned column like the original: one tall text block carries SOLSTICE, headline, intro and the three numbered steps in sequence, with the CTA pill anchored on the same left edge below and legal as a thin footer.

Two-column square: a wide left text column holds the full story top to bottom, while the CTA sits in the lower-right column, aligned to the column's bottom edge so the eye ends there after the steps, with legal spanning the base.
Centred symmetric poster: a full-width centred text stack fills the upper three quarters, with a centred CTA pill beneath on the same axis and a centred legal line closing the composition.
